|strategy=By Ryan Werntz, Red 13<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20010321011721/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/small/wioslea.html</ref>

Not only does [[Wioslea]] have a great deploy to power ratio, she has a destiny of 5 which fits right into an insert based deck. Deploy her at the [[Cloud City: Incinerator]] and couple her with [[Spaceport Speeders]] and an [[R2-X2 (Artoo-Extoo)]] and you have a great combination which allows you to activate a lot of Force without losing any cards. Place her in a [[Cloud City Sabacc]] based deck and you have a gambler and a great draw during Sabacc games.

Combos:

[[Wioslea]] + [[Cloud City: Incinerator]] + [[Spaceport Speeders]] + [[R2-X2 (Artoo-Extoo)]] - to create a great Force generator!

[[Wioslea]] + [[Cloud City Sabacc]] - to help you win Sabacc games!

A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 6 August 2016. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-wioslea-PC-Errata-2016-disc-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Wioslea (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same words as the previous version. This is a full card image again, with the printed art, title and lore (350 × 490 pixels); a small round bronze disc at the lower right marks it as errata.

The 2013 slip and the same area of the 2016 disc card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
